examName: NASCLA Accredited Examination for Commercial General Building Contractors
steps: Confirm your Contractor license is active and in good standing in New York.
Submit a license verification request from New York through the appropriate national registry or the state board directly.
File an application for full new application required with California's licensing board.
Register for and pass the required exam: NASCLA Accredited Examination for Commercial General Building Contractors.
Pay the California application fee (approx. $465) and submit supporting documents.
Await processing — typically 30-90 days in California.
notes: California's contractor licensing requirements are administered per the state's licensing authority. Most trade licenses in California are issued by the Contractors State License Board (CSLB); healthcare licenses go through the relevant state board (e.g., Board of Registered Nursing). Always confirm current rules directly with the official board before applying, since requirements change.
